page_note: Page contains the close of a chariot enumeration (ten cosmic chariots: First Man, Pillar of Glory, Call, Answer, living Air, Wind, Light, Water, Fire) — classic substrate teaching. A clear editorial seam appears at segs 14-19 where the cosmic ten is extended by four ecclesial 'mounting-places' identified with the standard Manichaean four-rank church (Elect male/female, Catechumens male/female), totaling twelve. The cosmic descent and redemption narrative resumes in 20-26. A chapter break separates this from a new chapter on the 'Interpretation of the Peace,' which opens with the standard apostolic dialogue frame followed by a substantive cosmological question about peace, right hand, salutation, and obeisance — a Persian-style enumerated topic.
